deck: Coca-Cola put out a trailer today for something called Fanta's Haunted Universe — four original characters the company owns outright, made with an entertainment studio, running through Halloween and beyond.  For the last two Halloweens Fanta rented horror instead, licensing Chucky, M3GAN and Freddy Fazbear from Universal and Blumhouse across roughly 50 markets. tldr: Fanta stopped licensing horror characters and launched four of its own this morning, after two years of renting Chucky and M3GAN across roughly 50 markets while Coca-Cola's sparkling flavours segment declined 1% for the year.  List every seasonal licence you pay for and get a costed proposal for building one owned character before the next renewal.

Kantar looked at more than 15,000 creator ads across 19 countries and found that only 49% have the creator say the brand name aloud, and that saying it is worth 22 percentile points of brand linkage.  Add a mandatory spoken brand mention to your creator brief template today and refuse delivery on cuts that skip it.

Disney ordered 20 episodes from Dhar Mann Studios, the third competing distributor to book his production line in thirteen months after Samsung and Fox, from a 125,000 square foot facility shipping five hours of scripted content a week.  Get a quote from a creator-owned studio alongside your agency's for your next video commission and compare cost per finished minute.

The Counter-Strike final at the Esports World Cup peaked at 1,037,179 concurrent viewers on Sunday against a tournament average of 308,396, a spike 3.4 times the average, while Gamescom Opening Night Live runs a ratio of about 1.1.  Ask for peak and average concurrents alongside hours watched on every live proposal and negotiate the final-day placement separately.

Bloomberg reported that TikTok withheld a published safety feature from 10% of its American users, roughly 15 million people, to measure the effect on daily usage, and two senators have given the company until 1 September to answer 13 questions.  Ask your platform reps in writing which safety features are active for the audiences in your current buy and keep the replies on file.

Twitch opened brand sponsorships to Affiliates worldwide last Thursday, after Minecraft campaigns in which over half the participating paid streamers were already Affiliates.  Run your next Twitch test entirely against certified Affiliates at the budget one Partner would have cost.

Felicia Day's Kickstarter closed at $6,820,829, the biggest crowdfunded film ever, from an audience she built on a web series that ended in 2013 and once funded with a PayPal button.  Ask every creator you are about to sign how many people they can reach without a platform, and weight your offer toward the ones with a number.

The global marketing boss described the switch himself, on the record, as "our move from collaborator to creator."
